name: Forest honey
summary: Mật ong Cát Bà is a product visitors buy. The special-zone list says mật ong rừng. The 5 April 2013 account says households sell it themselves and does not name a shop. The chiêm season is the one that account prefers. The month is Check on arrival.
howToEat: Buy it as honey. The 8 January 2016 article also names rượu mật ong as the drink beside the seafood. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: The island, including Xuân Đám and thị trấn Cát Bà on the 2013 beekeeping account. A shop door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Mật ong Cát Bà — forest honey
seoDescription: Cát Bà honey is dark yellow, thick, and fragrant on the 5 April 2013 account, best in the chiêm season. A shop door and a current price are Check on arrival.
culture: The 2013 account says the science ministry had certified the name “Mật ong Cát Bà”. A 2022 workshop was about a certification mark, “Cát Bà Xanh”, for the same honey.
taste: The 5 April 2013 account calls the honey dark yellow, thick, and fragrant, and says it is best in the chiêm season, from ong nội.
